source.title: Thador - Ironsworn General
source.name: Thador
source.description: A tough and reliable Tank who can summon ritual zones.

skills.name: Moonveil Manifest

description.raw: Thador slams the ground with his shield, dealing 320% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 2 tiles and conjuring a ritual zone for the Moonveil Rite. The ritual zone lasts for 12s and reduces the Crit DMG DEF of enemies within by 40. When enemies have accumulated damage totaling 1500% of Thador's initial ATK while inside the zone, he unleashes a shadow eruption dealing 160% of Team ATK damage to each enemy inside the zone. Each ally is then healed for 80% of the eruption's total damage dealt. The eruption can trigger once per Moonveil Rite.
active: Thador slams the ground with his shield, dealing 320% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 2 tiles and conjuring a ritual zone for the Moonveil Rite.
The ritual zone lasts for 12s and reduces the Crit DMG DEF of enemies within by 40.
When enemies have accumulated damage totaling 1500% of Thador's initial ATK while inside the zone, he unleashes a shadow eruption dealing 160% of Team ATK damage to each enemy inside the zone.
Each ally is then healed for 80% of the eruption's total damage dealt.
The eruption can trigger once per Moonveil Rite.

text: Increases the damage of the eruption to 170% of the Team ATK.
Increases the damage of the eruption to 180% of the Team ATK.
Increases the damage of the eruption to 190% of the Team ATK.
Increases the damage of the eruption to 200% of the Team ATK.

skills.description_lite: Thador deals AoE damage and performs the Moonveil Rite, inflicting debuffs on affected enemies.

skills.name: Darkmoon Pact

description.raw: Passive. During battle preparation, Thador designates the ally placed 1 tile behind him as his lieutenant. While Thador remains alive, his lieutenant gains 15 + 1.5 (SP-based) Crit. Active. Thador grants both himself and his lieutenant a shield that absorbs 350% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based) damage for 8s.

skills.name: Umbral Descent

description.raw: When Thador's lieutenant casts Ultimate for the first time, Thador summons the Darkmoon over the battlefield. While active, the Darkmoon deals 80% (ATK-based) damage to each enemy every 0.5s and reduces their Phys & Magic DEF by 55%. After 6s, the Darkmoon fades, dealing 520% (ATK-based) damage to each enemy. This effect can trigger once per battle.

text: Increases damage when the effect ends to 540% (ATK-based).
